page_title: WHU 3-0 LEE | West Ham v Leeds 24/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Anthony Taylor is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' 3 - 0 Goal! Crysencio Summerville tees up Callum Wilson (West Ham) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the right side of the goal. 3:0.
90+4' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+3' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Callum Wilson (West Ham) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Karl Darlow.
90+1' Facundo Buonanotte (Leeds) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90+1' Daniel Farke has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sebastiaan Bornauw (Leeds) replacing Brenden Aaronson.
90+1' Joel Piroe (Leeds) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The substitution has been made. Mohamadou Kante (West Ham) has replaced Taty Castellanos.
88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

87' Joel Piroe (Leeds) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Mads Hermansen didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
85' Leeds have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
79' 2 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) was set free in the area by Mateus Fernandes and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
78' Ao Tanaka will be replaced by Joel Piroe (Leeds).
78' Daniel Farke has decided to make a change. Facundo Buonanotte (Leeds) replaces Jayden Bogle.
75' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
70' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jaka Bijol will be replaced by Daniel James (Leeds).
69' Daniel Farke has decided to substitute Dominic Calvert-Lewin and he is replaced by Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds).
69' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
67' 1 - 0 Taty Castellanos (West Ham) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a bullet header from close range into the middle of the net. The score is 1:0.
67' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) will deliver the corner kick.
66' The corner from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is intercepted by Karl Darlow.
66' Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. It will be a corner kick for West Ham.
64' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
64' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
60' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
60' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
58' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
53' The ball rebounds to Taty Castellanos (West Ham) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
51' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
49' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
47' The shot by Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Mads Hermansen.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Pablo (West Ham) is replaced by Callum Wilson.
46' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' A rebound falls to Pablo (West Ham) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post.
45+1' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Mateus Fernandes (West Ham).
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the left post.
42' West Ham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
40' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
39' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
36' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.

35' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
31' James Justin (Leeds) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mads Hermansen intercepts the ball.
26' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
25' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) for his blatant foul.
24' The resulting corner from Ao Tanaka (Leeds) is cleared by the defence.
24' James Justin (Leeds) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

22' Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Karl Darlow thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
16' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Pablo (West Ham) inside the box.
14' West Ham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
12' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
12' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
10' Jaka Bijol (Leeds) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Anthony Taylor had an easy-decision to make.
9' The foul by Pablo (West Ham) was seen by Anthony Taylor who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
8' James Justin (Leeds) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
6' A pass by Pablo (West Ham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
5' A pass from James Justin (Leeds) is intercepted by Mads Hermansen and the move breaks down.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Leeds will have the kick-off.
